identity.name: The Estates at Acqualina
identity.hoa_name: Estates Master Association (related entity of Acqualina Ocean Residences & Resort Condominium Association, Inc.; managed by Acqualina Management, LLC, (305) 918-8000)
identity.notes: Ultra-luxury oceanfront condominium HOA community consisting of two high-rise towers (North and South) with approximately 248 residences at 17901 and 17975 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles Beach, FL 33160. Completed around 2022 as part of the Acqualina Resort campus, the community shares extensive resort-style amenities with the adjacent Acqualina Resort & Residences / Resort & Spa. The HOA manages common areas, security, and shared amenities in a secure oceanfront setting.

fees.note: Typically $1.50 to $2.00+ per square foot per month depending on unit size; listing examples show $3,655 to over $23,000 per month for larger residences. Exact figures, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments are not uniformly published and vary; not available in detail from public sources. CDD assessments not mentioned in sources. Broader Acqualina community (same campus) cited at $1.50-$2.50/sq ft with examples from several thousand to $10,000+/month.

amenities.detail: Multiple pools including oceanfront infinity pool, rooftop pool, family pool, lap pool, and children's pool with waterslide
Private oceanfront beach access with beach service/attendants
Full-service spa (ESPA spa on the Acqualina campus)
State-of-the-art fitness center; multiple fitness centers across the Acqualina campus
Unique simulators listed among resort amenities (specific type not detailed in sources)
Sports courts (listed for the broader Acqualina community shared with Estates at Acqualina)
Resort gardens (listed for the broader Acqualina campus)
Resort-style services including concierge and dining options via the adjacent Acqualina Resort & Spa
HOA-managed security in a secure oceanfront setting

demographics.geography_level: Area-level (approximate; source data covers a broader area than the ~248-residence building, e.g., ~19,666 housing units cited with Miami metro and Florida comparisons). Median age ~47.5, about 10% higher than Miami metro (41.8) and Florida (42.7).

proximity.nearest_name: Acqualina Resort & Spa / Acqualina Resort & Residences (adjacent on same campus)
